marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF964B Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a 3/4 in Hog Ring Anvil and a 20 V power source, delivering 1200 RPM. This tool has a durable Glass Filled Nylon housing and measures 10.7 in in length, 4-1/2 in in width, and 11.1 in in depth. The 4-mode push button switch and LED brightness control provide added functionality.
